channel.title: Nizar — theonlyengineer.com
channel.description: Notes from building generative-AI systems that survive real users: agents in production, evaluating LLM output, and the architecture and cost underneath.

item.title: Context is the hard part, and nobody sets out to build it
item.description: Why the same AI feature works at one company and fails at another: canonical definitions, current signals, and quality enforcement — the layers nobody budgets for.
item.author: nizar@theonlyengineer.com (Nizar)

item.title: The most expensive call is the one that fails after trying hardest
item.description: In a step-billed system your costliest interactions are the ones the model works hardest on and still can't finish. The effort paradox, and the four controls that bound it.
item.author: nizar@theonlyengineer.com (Nizar)

item.title: What an LLM feature actually costs to run
item.description: Cost is steps times tokens times retries, the failures dominate, and the pilot will not show you. The four buckets to model and the levers that actually move the bill.
item.author: nizar@theonlyengineer.com (Nizar)

item.title: Where AI belongs in your architecture — and where it doesn't
item.description: Models at the edges, deterministic code in the core. The patterns that don't need a model, the ones where it earns its keep, and the question to ask before adding it.
item.author: nizar@theonlyengineer.com (Nizar)

item.title: You can't debug what you can't see: observability for LLM features
item.description: What to record on every model call, why the rendered prompt is the field that matters most, and why instrumentation has to exist before the first incident.
item.author: nizar@theonlyengineer.com (Nizar)

item.title: Test one prompt a hundred times, not a hundred prompts once
item.description: Single-run prompt testing hides variance, tail latency, token spread and intermittent misbehaviour. How to build the batch harness that surfaces them.
item.author: nizar@theonlyengineer.com (Nizar)

item.title: Constrain the model, don't review its output
item.description: Inconsistent generated output is a constraint problem, not a capability problem. Schemas and closed vocabularies beat review queues, and here is why.
item.author: nizar@theonlyengineer.com (Nizar)

item.title: How to evaluate an LLM feature before you ship it
item.description: Why normal testing doesn't work on a probability distribution, what goes in an adversarial case set, and how to score it without fooling yourself.
item.author: nizar@theonlyengineer.com (Nizar)

item.title: An agent is a state machine with an LLM picking the transitions
item.description: Orchestration is not reasoning. Which decisions to encode in code, which to leave to the model, and what an explicit generation graph buys you.
item.author: nizar@theonlyengineer.com (Nizar)

item.title: Long-running agents belong in a queue, not a request
item.description: Why multi-step generation cannot live in an HTTP request, what the queue-plus-stream architecture looks like, and the worker settings that decide whether it degrades gracefully.
item.author: nizar@theonlyengineer.com (Nizar)

item.title: Your agent doesn't need to be smart. It needs to be narrow.
item.description: A boring agent that produces a useful artifact every time beats a clever one that mostly does. How to scope a task narrowly enough to be validated, tested and trusted.
item.author: nizar@theonlyengineer.com (Nizar)

item.title: What it actually takes to put an LLM agent in production
item.description: The checklist that separates a working demo from a system you can leave running: scope, control flow, queues, evaluation, constraints, cost and visibility.
item.author: nizar@theonlyengineer.com (Nizar)

item.title: Modernizing OnPrem Infrastructure
item.description: Bringing cloud-native tools into your on-prem infrastructure for automation and resiliency.
item.author: nizar@theonlyengineer.com (Nizar)

item.title: Automating HPC Infrastructure
item.description: Using Apache CloudStack to manage cloud resources in your on-prem infrastructure.
item.author: nizar@theonlyengineer.com (Nizar)
